👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, India mein alcohol brand banana bahar se jitna glamorous lagta hai, andar se utna hi bada sardard hai. Agar aaj aap ek nayi beer launch karte ho, toh aapki MRP ka 50–80% hissa seedha sarkar ki jeb mein chala jata hai. Yaani risk aapka, mehnat aapki, capital aapka… par aapse zyada paisa sarkar kama rahi hoti hai. Agar kisi tarah aap retailer tak pahunch bhi gaye, toh shelves par already Kingfisher, Old Monk, aur Budweiser jaise giants baithe hote hain, jinke saamne naye brand ki value banana bahut mushkil ho jata hai.
Aur maan lo retailer ne aapka product rakh bhi liya, toh customer aayega kaise? Kyunki India mein alcohol ki marketing almost banned hai. Itna sab karne ke baad bhi expansion ek nightmare ban jata hai—ek state se doosre state tak maal bhejne mein paperwork aur bureaucracy ka aisa jaal hai jo business shuru hone se pehle hi khatam kar de.
Lekin isi highly regulated, heavily taxed aur hyper-competitive market mein bhi BroCode ke founder Sameer Mahandru ne ek aisa loophole aur market gap dhundha ki sirf 7 saalon mein, bina traditional rules follow kiye, unhone ₹330 crore ka empire khada kar diya—woh bhi tax benefits ke saath. Toh sawaal yeh hai: itne competitive space mein BroCode kaise launch hua? Jin taxes se businesses band ho jaate hain, unhi taxes ka fayda kaise uthaya gaya? Aur is legendary strategy se hum kya seekh sakte hain—yeh sab jaanenge is episode mein.
